reason: The README describes an MCP server whose primary purpose is connecting AI agents to local Stata for data analysis, statistical workflows, and related Stata code assistance.

summaries.zh: 通过 MCP 将 AI 智能体连接到本地 Stata，以执行数据分析、统计工作流并辅助处理 Stata 代码。
summaries.en: Connects AI agents to a local Stata installation through MCP for data analysis, statistical workflows, and Stata code assistance.

capabilities: Invokes a locally installed Stata executable through an MCP server
Enables AI agents to run Stata data-analysis workflows and interpret statistical results
Provides installation and configuration commands for supported agent clients
Includes Stata language-server integration for syntax awareness and completion
